name: compact-adviser
description: A single-plugin marketplace for compact-adviser, which tells you when your Grok session has reached a good point to run /compact.

plugins.name: compact-adviser
plugins.description: Stop guessing when to run /compact. Watches your session and suggests compaction at a completed checkpoint - after work lands, not mid-task - so you keep context you still need and drop what you do not. Hint-only on Grok: the hint is painted on the status row and never enters the model's context. Judgment runs through the TypeSafe Jev API and needs your own key.
